photos.c:
MANN SUPREME - CHEF RUNS OFF WITH AWARD. Marathon champion Lionel Mann, the Galloping Cordon Bleu, being presented with the "Mitchell Trophy" for the first Belgrave Harrier home in the "Poly Marathon". The "Mitchell Trophy"is being awarded by the donor of this magnificent shield, Bert Mitchell of 32, Manor Road, Deal. Bert was formerly a fierce competitor and still remains a staunch Belgrave Harrier.
The ceremony was conducted at the 21st Annual 20 Mile Road Race at Wimbledon where Lionel also ran a blistering 1hr 54 minutes for the course.
Top: Bert Mitchell sends the 100 odd starters on their way for the 1976 Belgrave '20'.
